title: Find the Distance Value Between Two Arrays
goal: Count first-array values farther than d from every second-array value.
strategy: Select each arr1 candidate, compare it with arr2 values, and reject it immediately when a blocker is within distance d. Otherwise, count it.

phasePurposes.start: Initialize the arrays, distance limit, and running count.
phasePurposes.inspect: Highlight the exact source cells, connect them to the comparison cards, and calculate their absolute distance.
phasePurposes.update: Accept or reject the candidate, update the observed nearest gap, and update the count.
phasePurposes.done: Display the final distance value and completed candidate decisions.

edgeCases: Equality at the distance boundary rejects the candidate.
Zero distance rejects only exact matches.
Duplicate values are separate array elements.
checks: SVG connections originate from the active source cells.
The candidate connection remains while blockers change.
Connections update when indices or layout dimensions change.
Nearest gaps never reveal future comparisons.
The running count matches accepted verdicts.
Both light and dark themes remain readable.
inputRules: Distance d is an integer between 0 and 100.

verification.reason: Tests and builds have not been executed in the user's project.
